questions.q: You can buy that/ you want if/ you top this exam.
o: You can buy that
you want if
you top this exam.
No error
questions.s: Explanation:- Yahan buy verb ko object ki zarurat hai. Yaani noun clause ki zarurat hai. Isliye yahan 'that' ka nahi what/whatever ka use hoga what ka arth hoga jo tumhe chahiye aur whatever ka arth hoga jo bhi tumhe chahye. Dono hi use kiye jaa sakte hain.

questions.q:
He is as concerned as me / regarding / the examination schedule.

(SSC Selection Post phase-X 28/06/23)
o: He is as concerned as me
questions.s:
The erroneous part is "as me". The correct form should be "as I".

After "as" in comparative structures, the subject form of the pronoun (i.e., "I") should be used, not the object form ("me").

Correct sentence: He is as concerned as I regarding the examination schedule.

questions.q: Q3. You may be an editor or a reporter, (a)/ this makes you sit,(b)/ that makes you run.(c)/ no error (d)
o: A) You may be an editor or a reporter, (a)
questions.s: 'That' refers to the first mentioned (editor) and 'this' refers to the last mentioned (reporter). Since a reporter runs and an editor sits, it should be 'this makes you run' and 'that makes you sit'.

questions.q: Q40. Q40. After spending an hour at the beach, we finally got out and dried us.
questions.s: The subject is "we", so the reflexive action requires the pronoun "ourselves", not "us".

questions.q: Q23. The people in (a)/my office are (b)/smarter than other offices.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.s: This is a comparison error. You cannot compare 'people' to 'offices'. It should be 'than those of other offices'.

questions.q:
These tutorials are so elementary that they can help neither you nor I.

[CPO Tier II 08 Νου 2021]
questions.s:
Answer: neither you nor I

Replace I with me. The pronoun me is the correct objective case to match the verb help.

Correct Sentence: These tutorials are so elementary that they can help neither you nor me.

questions.q: The Taj Mahal / is one of / the most beautiful / creation in the world.
questions.s: Explanation:- Yahan "of" Preposition selection ko dikhane ke liye use ki gayi hai isliye iske baad aane wala Noun Plural me prayog kiya jayega isliye 'Creation' nahi 'Creations' ka use hoga.

questions.q: One should keep ( their ) word.
questions.s: Possessive case of ‘one’ is ‘one’s’.

questions.q: Q3. Q3. Lodi Colony in Delhi is very different from other -R places in the city that is crowded and noisy. [SSC CGL 07/06/2019 Shift-01]
questions.s: Relative pronoun 'that' का antecedent 'other places' plural है, इसलिए 'is' के स्थान पर plural verb 'are' का प्रयोग होगा।

questions.q: It will / be us who will / buy a new house / No error.
o: It will
be us who will
buy a new house
No error
questions.s: Explanation:-  Yahan 'it' introductory subject hai. Hume real subject 'we' par stress daalna tha isliye yahan Subjective case 'we' ka use hoga na ki objective case 'us' ka.

questions.q:
Choose the most suitable pronouns for the given sentence:
If_____catch a cold,______can spread to others.
questions.s: "You" is used here to talk about people in general (second-person pronoun). "It" refers back to "a cold" mentioned in the sentence (third-person singular pronoun for things). Only option 2 correctly shows that when "you" (any person) catches "a cold," then "it" (the cold) spreads to others.

questions.q:
Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.

We have finished our work for the day, so let we go home early today.
questions.s: The correct answer is 'let us go.' In the underlined segment, the use of the pronoun 'we' is incorrect. The pronoun 'we' is used as the subject of a verb for talking about the speaker and one or more other people. In the first part of the given sentence, the pronoun 'We' is acting as the subject of the verb but in the underlined segment it is acting as an object of the verb. Therefore, the pronoun 'us' should be used in place of the pronoun 'we' in the underlined segment.

questions.q: Q50. Q50. The employees blamed no one but ______ for the failure of the project, acknowledging that they had ignored critical warnings.
questions.s: The subject is "The employees" and the action reflects back on them. The correct reflexive pronoun is "themselves".

questions.q: She is the woman/who I know,/ you can trust blindly.
o: She is the woman
who I know,
you can trust blindly.
no error
questions.s:
Ans (b) replace 'who' with 'whom'.

Yahan relative pronoun 'trust' verb ke liye lagana hai. Jise object chahiye. Isliye whom ka use hoga.

Note :- Relative pronoun who/whom ka yahan 'know' verb se koi relation nahi hai.

questions.q:
Chillies have a strong, spicy taste that tingle your taste buds.

[CGL Tier II 18/11/2020]
questions.s:
Correct Answer: that tingles

  • Corrected Sentence: Chillies have a strong, spicy taste that tingles your taste buds.

  • The subject "taste" is singular, so the verb "tingles" (singular form) agrees with it.

  • "That" correctly introduces the relative clause describing the "strong, spicy taste.”

questions.q: Mr. Sunil Pawar, our representative / he will / attend the meeting /on our behalf.
o: Mr. Sunil Pawar, our representative
he will
attend the meeting
on our behalf
questions.s: Explanation:- Yahan Mr. Sunil Pawar subject ki tarah se work kar raha hai, our representative case in apposition hai jo subject ko define kar rha hai aage aane wali verb subject 'Sunil Pawar' ko milni chahiye thi. Isliye yahan likha gya 'he' pronoun superfluous hai use hata den

questions.q: Q37. Q37. This is one of the boldest economic reform which have ever been introduced.
questions.s: The structure "one of the" must be followed by a plural noun ("reforms"). Superlatives ("boldest") are usually followed by "that". The verb "have" agrees with the plural "reforms".

questions.q: Companies will go / after one other in / their marketing campaigns. (SSC MTS Tier-01 02/05/23)
questions.s: 'One other' is incorrect. The correct reciprocal pronoun here is 'one another'.

questions.q:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

A man tends to one / of the horses after it’s / training at a stud farm.
questions.s: In the given sentence, ' it's' is incorrect a contraction for 'it is or it has'. Example: It's a beautiful artwork. But here we will use 'its' which is the possessive form of 'it.' Example: The cat was sleeping. It cocked up its ears on hearing the sound.

questions.q: All the technology which we use in our daily lives is advancing rapidly.
o: we use in our daily
lives is advancing rapidly
All the technology which
questions.s:
If ‘all’ denotes non-living things, ‘that’ is used and not ‘who’ or ‘whom’. So, the correct option would be: (c) All the technology which

Here's the corrected version: "All the technology that we use in our daily lives is advancing rapidly."

questions.q: A misunderstanding has crept / between he / and his sister. (SSC CGL Tier-02 08/08/22)
questions.s: After a preposition like 'between', the object form of the pronoun ('him') must be used.

questions.q: Q8. Q8. They each listen carefully (a)/to each other says as (b)/they love each other a lot. (c)/no error (d)
o: they love each other a lot
questions.s: 'Each other' एक reciprocal pronoun है जो subject नहीं बन सकता। यहाँ object के रूप में 'to what each other says' होना चाहिए।

questions.q: Most of us hesitate to accept our mistakes.
questions.s:
(a) No substitution required

Explanation:- yhan 'Most of Us ' ka meaning hai hum logon me se jadatar. Much uncountable ke liye aata hai , more comparison ke liye aata hai aur lots many jaisa koi adj nhi hota isliye b, c ,d options nhi ho sakte.

questions.q: We hardly knew nothing / about the manager / who had recently joined. (SSC CGL TIER-01 25/07/23)
questions.s: 'Hardly' and 'nothing' create a double negative. The correct phrase is 'hardly knew anything'.

questions.q: Q28. He is (a)/the same man (b)/which I saw (c)/yesterday at the gate.(d)
questions.s: After the phrase 'the same', the relative pronoun 'that' is used instead of 'who' or 'which'.
